selected_script.angle: Stop scrubbing grout on your knees with a tiny brush and use the stand-up V-brush instead
selected_script.hook: I used to scrub grout like this and my knees gave up before the floor looked clean.

script_record.concept_name: Knees Gave Up Before The Grout Did
script_record.voiceover: I used to scrub grout like this and my knees gave up before the floor looked clean. The line still looked dark, and I was just smearing dirty water around. Then I switched to Grout-eez with the stand-up grout brush. Quick apply, scrub the line while standing, then wipe it up. Way easier—and you can actually see the cleaner grout line. If your tile is ceramic or porcelain, try this before kneeling again.

timeline.audio: Natural brush scraping and slight room tone. VO begins: 'I used to scrub grout like this and my knees gave up before the floor looked clean.'

timeline.visual: The person reaches to the side of the floor and brings in the real Grout Cleaner Kit: white 32 oz Grout-eez bottle with red and blue front label, ribbed white neck and cap, plus bright blue V-shaped grout brush head with angled threaded socket attached to a plain standard pole. Product colors, label placement, proportions, plastic bottle, glossy label, blue brush head, and dense white twisted nylon bristles remain accurate. product_consistency_rules: Preserve the white 32 oz Grout-eez cleaner bottle with red and blue front label, Clean-eez logo at top, ribbed white neck, white cap, smooth bottle body, and glossy printed label.
Preserve the bright blue V-shaped grout brush head with wide low shape, angled blue threaded socket, and dense white twisted nylon bristles.
Keep the bottle-to-brush size ratio accurate: bottle taller, brush head wider and lower.
Do not add buttons, lights, electronic parts, extra attachments, new packaging, or decorative accessories.
Show use only on ceramic or porcelain tile; do not imply natural stone safety.
negative_constraints: No UI, subtitles, stickers, banners, captions, or text overlays.
No unrealistic sparkle bursts, extreme foaming, smoke, acid effects, or instant magical color change.
No polished studio pack-shot intro; keep it handheld and home-cleaning realistic.
No claims of disinfecting, whitening, repairing grout, or safe use on natural stone.

final_moyin_jobs.promptText: Create one complete approximately 10-second vertical 9:16 TikTok-style UGC ad in a real US home kitchen with ceramic or porcelain tile floor, shot on a handheld phone with natural light and slight realistic camera movement. Preserve exact product identity, color, label placement, shape, material, texture, and proportions from the reference image; do not add nonexistent accessories or change the package. Show a small realistic amount of cleaner being applied along one grout line, then the blue V-shaped brush scrubbing the grout line while the person stands upright, with controlled realistic scrubbing and no dramatic foam. 8.5-10s credible before-after result proof and light CTA: stable close-up from the same floor angle shows one nearby grout line still dark and the cleaned line visibly lighter and neater after wiping; the Grout-eez bottle and blue brush rest beside the cleaned tile as proof. Keep the result realistic, not magically perfect. Conversational voiceover: 'I used to scrub grout like this and my knees gave up before the floor looked clean.
